observations.why: First-person plural 'we' enacts communal-sharing: the decision is presented as a collective identity move, not an individual's command.
Proportionality framing — quantified cost/benefit comparison positions the choice in market-pricing terms.
Declarative scheduling of a migration start enacts authority-ranking: a timeline is set without consultation or reciprocity framing.
Summary recapitulates the proportionality case in cost/benefit terms; the bulleted register formalizes the market-pricing frame.
